content.expected_result: A relative edit rejects an old digest; complete whiteboard publication is a separate current-content replacement.
preconditions: Use a named current board and a diagram-sourced slide with an observed authoring snapshot. The public diagram edit command targets slides; whiteboard publish supplies a complete board.

steps.action: Move a diagram element, then repeat that relative edit against the old snapshot. Inspect the current snapshot after refusal.
steps.expected_result: The delta is rejected before applying twice, the published slide stays unchanged, and no whiteboard is implicitly republished or assigned a parent graph.

content.title: Separate complete whiteboard publication from relative diagram edits
